sources.title: Edwards Lookout Tower Map - Graham County, Arizona, USA

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: location, reservation, status and mapped elevation only. No build date, design, staffing, fire or removal history in any page read. The westlookouts Edwards page carries only heading lines, no narrative. Mapcarta's 6,411 ft (1,954 m) could fill elevation_m after review. Record agency 'San Carlos Apache Reservation' is a place, not an agency; no source read names the managing agency. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403 and was not read. The story body runs about 80 words, under the 120-word floor, because no further evidence was found; it is kept short rather than padded. Human check advised before any visitor guidance.
